problem_statement: When a 6LoWPAN mesh message is prepared for transmission, the framer must reject a message whose payload does not fit into a single MAC frame, and must succeed when it does fit. Currently the framer reports success and returns the message length even for a message whose payload is larger than the available frame space, so an oversized mesh frame is accepted instead of producing an out-of-buffer error. The behavior must distinguish a message that exactly fills the frame, one that overflows by even a single byte, and one that fits with one byte to spare, reporting an error in the overflow case.
